links.comparator_used: Prompt 1, a HIPAA-aligned baseline prompt without the institutional PHI categories
links.outcome: Recovery of institutional PHI categories missed by the baseline prompt, plus precision
links.effect: Naming the missed categories recovered 79% (48/61) of them; adding instructions against over-redaction restored precision
links.quote: Naming the missed categories recovered 79\% (48/61) of them, and discouraging over-redaction restored precision.

links.comparator_used: Purpose-built de-identification systems (Stanford TiDE, OpenMed PII) and pattern-based baselines
links.outcome: PHI de-identification F1, with the advantage concentrated in contextual categories
links.tradeoff: LLMs cost more to run than traditional methods
links.quote: LLMs outperformed the purpose-built systems (best F1=0.918$\pm$0.001 vs.\ TiDE 0.779), with advantages concentrated in contextual categories.
